author: CNN
description: Far-right Israeli Minister of National Security Itamar Ben Gvir boasted of the construction of a new gallows for hanging Palestinians facing the death sentence. The site, he said, will have a viewing area. Earlier this year, Ben Gvir led an effort to broaden Israel’s death penalty so it effectively applies to Palestinians convicted of terrorism, but not to Israelis. With elections two months away, Ben Gvir’s rhetoric seems unlikely to stop.
title: Far-right Israeli minister brags of gallows for hanging Palestinians

#CNN #News

author: CNN
description: Four years after the death of Mahsa Amini, and the “Women, Life, Freedom” protests that followed, it seems the way Iranian women dress is back in the spotlight. As the US-Iran war stalls, videos circulating on social media show women being shamed on the streets for what they’re wearing, particularly if they don’t have the mandatory hijab on. CNN’s Jomana Karadsheh reports.
title: There’s a renewed crackdown on how Iranian women dress
